floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 8 confirmed; 8 diffs are TWO independent reg-alloc/scheduling ties (inner sum/j $a0 swap; 2nd-loop LICM-const vs move preheader order) — both pure-C, greg-characterized, frontier built.
Region A quantified as a pure sum/j $a0<->$a1 swap (all surroundings match target); naive structural levers KILLED, pointing to the directed permuter.

Region A range-mechanism CONFIRMED: offset+=j flips the sum/j a0/a1 swap (score 7) but is not match-viable; zero-cost manual flips killed, so the flip needs the directed permuter's whole-function LUID
Directed permuter (real full-TU basin) found do-while(0) on sum=0 that solves Region A and lowers the honest floor 8->6; Region B has no clean permuter lever (all sub-130 finds invalid).
Fresh-seed floor-6 permuter (20.9k iters) + exhaustive preheader lineswap reconfirm no clean lever: Region A' tie unreachable by statement reorder, Region B yields only dead-alias cheats.

Forensics: both floor-6 residuals named to one GCC decision each (A'=sched.c rank_for_schedule INSN_LUID tiebreak coupled to the do-while(0) def-relocation; B=loop.c move_movables emit_insn_before(loo

Forensics: CORRECTED Region A mechanism — the do-while(0)'s sum=a0 flip is a loop-depth-weighted reg_n_refs TIE (10->11) broken by allocno number (sum 77<j 79), NOT live_length (LL=9 unchanged on both

frontier.hypothesis: A whole-function structure gives sum weighted-n_refs >= 11 (tie/beat j) WITHOUT a loop-note bracket at sum=0's def, so sum=0 keeps low LUID (emitted first, A' closed) while still winning $a0 via the allocno tiebreak.
frontier.mechanism: reg_n_refs += loop_depth (flow.c): sum needs one more depth-weighted reference than the plain-form's 10. The do-while(0) supplies it via a NOTE_INSN_LOOP_BEG that also block-bottoms sum=0. Any lever that raises sum's ref weight through a DIFFERENT block (e.g. a genuine loop-carried use, or deeper nesting of the accumulate that the target's semantics actually admit) would add the +1 without the preheader-schedule coupling.
frontier.next_probe: Directed permuter on the floor-6 full-TU basin biased to structural mutations OUTSIDE the preheader that add a real depth>=1 sum reference or rebalance the accumulate nesting; reject any synthetic/dead extra ref (cheat). s4/s5 fresh-seed campaigns found none — seed toward accumulate-region restructures, not preheader reorders (measured dead).

frontier.hypothesis: Drop j's loop-depth-weighted reg_n_refs from 11 to 10 so the plain (low-LUID) sum=0 form ties j and wins $a0 via the allocno tiebreak with NO do-while(0) at all.
frontier.mechanism: j total 11 = j=0(depth1) + j++(set+use,depth2) + j<0x24(depth2). Moving any j ref to a shallower depth drops the weight. j=0 at depth 0 would give j=10.
frontier.next_probe: Find a loop shape where the counter is initialized once at function scope yet still resets per outer iteration without a depth-1 store (measured-blocked so far: j must be 0 at each inner-loop entry). Explore whether a pointer-end / difference counter reformulation legitimately removes a depth-2 j reference while keeping target's `sltiu ...,0x24` byte — prior pointer-end attempts diverged from target's integer counter.

frontier.hypothesis: Region B closes only if the two LICM invariants get LOWER LUID than the ap/a2p moves without a pre-loop reference (constant-holder cheat) — unchanged from s6.
frontier.mechanism: loop.c move_movables emit_insn_before(loop_start) hard-codes the hoist point at preheader END; invariants referenced only inside the k-loop => LICM controls placement.
frontier.next_probe: Design a k-loop where the range-test bound is genuinely loop-carried with a real dependency chain to the pointer moves (raising the moves' LUID above the constants); vet against constant-holder/dead-alias. All regionB-* attempts invalid/cheat s1-s6.
